hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.go) PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH" goimports -w "$f" ;; esac; case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.ts|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.tsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.jsx|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.css|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.json|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.html|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web/"*.md) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/web" && npx prettier --write "$f") ;; esac
